items.translation: 参见静态工厂方法，位于 MockMvcResultMatchers 和 MockMvcResultHandlers。

items.source: If a single Error or Exception is thrown, it will be rethrown.
items.translation: 如果抛出单个 Error 或 Exception，它将重新抛出。

items.source: This feature is similar to the SoftAssertions support in AssertJ and the assertAll() support in JUnit Jupiter.
items.translation: 此功能类似于 AssertJ 中的 `SoftAssertions` 支持和 JUnit Jupiter 中的 `assertAll()` 支持。

items.source: Instead of invoking andExpect() multiple times, you can invoke andExpectAll() as in the following example.
items.translation: 与其多次调用 `andExpect()`，您可以像以下示例一样调用一次 `andExpectAll()`。

items.source: You can invoke andExpect() multiple times as in the following example.
items.translation: 您可以像以下示例中那样多次调用andExpect()。

items.source:
Perform a general action.

Example

static imports: MockMvcRequestBuilders.*, MockMvcResultMatchers.*

mockMvc.perform(get("/form")).andDo(print());
Return the result of the executed request for direct access to the results.
items.translation: 返回直接访问结果的已执行请求的结果。

items.source: Rossen Stoyanchev, Sam Brannen, Michał Rowicki

If multiple exceptions are thrown, this method will throw an AssertionError whose error message is a summary of all the exceptions. In addition, each exception will be added as a suppressed exception to the AssertionError.
items.translation: 如果抛出多个异常，此方法将抛出一个 `AssertionError`，其错误消息是所有异常的摘要。此外，每个异常都将作为 `抑制的异常` 添加到该 `AssertionError` 中。

items.source:
Perform multiple expectations, with the guarantee that all expectations
will be asserted even if one or more expectations fail with an exception.
items.translation: 执行多个期望，并保证即使有一个或多个期望因异常而失败，所有期望仍会被断言。
